road.jaymospowers.web.anti: Keep it white until it trusts you wholly.
road.jaymospowers.web.quiet: Meet the Quiet One: watch the old war told, or have him wake as your own spirit.
road.jaymospowers.chrono.workshop: Find the Tinkerer's workshop, and let him talk.
road.jaymospowers.chrono.fell: Bring the Tinkerer down once, and see who stands up where he fell.
message.jaymospowers.road.web_white: The white one leaves a few words on a blank page, and goes quiet again.
book.jaymospowers.web_white.page2:
Not hungry. Not now.

There was a man, once, who held us like this. We held him back.
book.jaymospowers.web_white.page3:
He never said much.

We have kept that.
